mapper.insert: insert into notes (id, user_id, title, content_markdown, content_html, author, cover_url, like_count, comment_count, create_time, update_time, status) values(#{id},#{userId},#{title},#{contentText},#{contentHtml},#{author},#{coverUrl},0,0,NOW(),NOW(),'active')
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, title, content_markdown as contentMarkdown, content_html as contentHtml, author, cover_url as coverUrl, like_count as likeCount, comment_count as commentCount, create_time as createTime from notes where id = #{noteId} and status = 'active' limit 1

select id, note_id as noteId, user_id as userId, author, content, create_time as createTime from note_comments where note_id = #{noteId} and status = 'active' order by create_time asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into note_comments (id, note_id, user_id, author, content, create_time, status) values(#{id},#{noteId},#{userId},#{author},#{content},NOW(),'active')
mapper.select: select count(*) from notes where status = 'active'
mapper.update: update notes set cover_url = concat('https://picsum.photos/seed/note-', id, '/800/600'), update_time = NOW() where status = 'active' and (cover_url is null or cover_url = '')
